description:
Long, long ago, there lived a mermaid princess named Lara. She was raised with love by her father, the king of the sea kingdom, and her older sisters.

One day, Lara fell in love with a human prince who lived on land. It was a forbidden love, one that was not allowed in the world of mermaids. Still, Lara journeyed to the surface. With a potion, given to her from the witch Grace, she became human. But the potion came at a cost: fail to find true love, she would turn into foam. Though she was a princess of the sea, Lara chose love. Yet, her wish went unfulfilled and perished into the sea.

Two hundred years later, Lara awakens once more in Lake Biwa to finally search for her true love.

All because of "love".

(Source: Crunchyroll News, edited)

__Height:__ 165cm

Lara was once a mermaid princess who fell in love with a human prince and disappeared into sea foam before her love could be fulfilled. She has now been reborn as a human being off the shore of Lake Biwa in Shiga Prefecture roughly 200 years later. With her new life, she is once again looking for true love.

__Height:__ 150cm

A high school girl living in Ootsu City, Shiga Prefecture who does boxing. After the loss of her mother at a young age she lives with her grandmother, father, and older brother. One day she encounters [Lara](https://anilist.co/character/368281/Lara) and invites her to live with her family.

The witch who turned [Lara](https://anilist.co/character/368281/Lara) into a human. She is a criminal who was outcast from mermaid society, and now is taking the form of a fish in order to get close to [Mari](https://anilist.co/character/375976/Mari-Otsu).

__Height:__ 170cm

A boy [Lara](https://anilist.co/character/368281/Lara) meets by chance who resembles [the prince](https://anilist.co/character/407723/Ouji) she loved 200 years ago.

__Height:__ 165cm

Lara's fourth older sister. She cared deeply for Lara and she was very affectionate toward her.

She is close friends with an anglerfish. She has now taken on a human form and is searching for the revived Lara. It seems she harbors special feelings toward humans...

__Height:__ 178cm

Mari's older brother. He is a third-year student at the same high school as Mari. He has lots of friends, but often skips school. 

His hobby is riding motorcycles.
